Question 5

Find the general solution to the differential equation dydx−yx=xy2.

 y=5xC−2x5/2
b
 y=±xC+x5/2
c
 y=5xC+x3/2
d
 y=(2xC−x3/2)2
e
 y=x2C−5x5/2
